page_title: HOL 2-4 EIN | Holstein Kiel v Eintracht Frankfurt 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Tobias Stieler has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' The ball is out of play. Holstein Kiel will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+2' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) will take a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' The number of offsides is – 1:1.
86' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Hugo Larsson.
83' The substitution is prepared. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fares Chaibi.
80' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Stieler and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
80' Holstein Kiel keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
78' Marcel Rapp decides to make a substitution. Carl Johansson will be replaced by Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Shuto Machino leaves the pitch and Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) comes on.
77' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:9.

74' 2 - 4 Goal! Omar Marmoush shows great vision to find Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails low into the middle of the goal. 2:4.
73' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
70' Tobias Stieler shows a yellow card to Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
70' The resulting corner, taken by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt), comes to nothing.
68' Today's match ends for Igor Matanovic who will be replaced by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
68' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Junior Dina Ebimbe.
67' Substitution. Finn Porath makes his way off the pitch and Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) comes on as his replacement.
67' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
65' 2 - 3 Goal! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:3.
64' It looks like Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Stieler won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

61' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Timon Weiner to get hold of the ball.
60' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Armin Gigovic as he is replaced by Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel).
58' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
57' A cross from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a corner.
55' The ratio of the ball possession is 45:55.
51' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) is given a fully deserved yellow card.

50' 2 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Kaua Santos, so the score changes to 2:2.
49' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

47' 1 - 2 The score has changed – 1:2. Omar Marmoush sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) jumps highest and plants a header down into the middle of the net.
47' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
47' The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Dino Toppmoller gives a chance to Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Aurele Amenda is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Timon Weiner pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
44' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
43' Timon Weiner displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
42' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
41' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) picks up an injury.
40' Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
36' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Tobias Stieler due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) and his team.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) was quite harsh and Tobias Stieler didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' 0:2 – the corner kicks stats.
32' The resulting corner from Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
30' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Kaua Santos no chance!
30' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
30' Referee Tobias Stieler is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Holstein Kiel!
29' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Holstein Kiel using VAR. Let's see what happens.

29' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Holstein Kiel!
28' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:3.

25' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 0:1. Timon Weiner was helpless.

23' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Kaua Santos. This effort didn't really trouble him.
23' A raking crossfield pass from Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.

20' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Kaua Santos, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
18' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
18' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
17' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
15' The ball possession at the moment is 43:57.
14' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.
10' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
7' A clumsy foul by Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle.
6' Holstein Kiel are seeing far more of the ball now.
4' Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Eintracht Frankfurt will have the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler will referee today's match.
